entities.summary: Ignacy Ludwik Pawłowski, Korwin coat of arms was a Roman Catholic archbishop of the Archdiocese of Mohilev from 1841 to his death in 1842. He previously served as auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Kamianets-Podilskyi and titular bishop of Megara from 1827 to 1841.
